purpose: ADR-003 tracking asset read by production (turret_mixed.yaml tracking.core) and the 3a host. Assembled by tools/tracking/tracking.py assemble; do not edit by hand.

provenance.process_density_rad2_s3: a person turning or walking at 3-10 m: LOS accelerations of order 0.5 rad/s^2 held for ~0.1 s, q = A^2 T
provenance.measurement_floor_rad2: 1 px at fx 1389 (the floor; each observation carries its own pixel noise through the camera Jacobian)
provenance.pixel_sigma_px: detector anchor on a 640x360 inference image scaled to 1920x1080: about one inference pixel
provenance.scale_max: max(1, A^2 T_m / q_a) with A = 2 rad/s^2 and T_m = 0.111 s (the ~9 fps delivered rate measured 2026-09-29)
provenance.fresh_s / horizon_s: fresh: normal age at use (latency 0.06 + frame 0.111 + jitter); horizon: the AUTO_TRACK coast of 0.5 s beyond it
provenance.level1: lambda 4 rad/s (the production tracking_reference_omega). Limits: owner ruling 2026-10-02, AUTO_TRACK is limited only by the 100 RPM safety cap and physical capability, not by a motion profile. Yaw: v 100 RPM; a = half of (3 A peak - 1 A worst friction) / inertia 0.0407 = 24.56 rad/s^2 (the other half is feedback headroom); j = half of the servo's 200 A/s current slew / inertia = 2456.0 rad/s^3. Pitch: v 100 RPM; a/j the 60 deg/s^2 / 300 deg/s^3 its commissioning exercised -- its capability under the 3 kg payload is unmeasured and Level 1's braking into the end stops relies on a real number. Travel: replaced each tick by the station's soft envelope.
provenance.lead_limit_rad: 2 deg: ten times the worst servo moving error measured by the yaw accuracy calibration

stage2.estimator: prior (stage 1): R and q_a need a moving subject (stage 2)
stage2.level1: prior: lambda from the stage-2 solve; limits by owner ruling (100 RPM, physical capability)
stage2.pixel_sigma_px: prior (stage 1): measured from a still subject in stage 2
stage2.timing: measured 2026-10-02 (tracking.py timing, sessions timing-timing-1, timing-fixed8ms-timing-1): uncertainty 3.9 ms
